verdict.rationale: The skill documents a file-based install: copy the SKILL.md folder into the personal or project skills directory, after which the agent picks it up automatically. An agent could plausibly run that headlessly. It also documents /plugin marketplace commands, but these are in-session slash commands, and nothing states that any path is designed or tested for unattended agent execution. Missing for 10: an explicit non-interactive/headless install command (e.g. a scripted CLI or one-liner), documentation that an agent can self-install end to end without prompts, and hands-on corroboration.
